Subject: Request: sponsor-match credits for Lumina (SeedBridge cohort 6)

Hi Karthik,

I'm coordinating sponsor matching for SeedBridge cohort 6 and wanted to check Redwood's program for credits/support. Lumina AI (cc'd - CEO Aisha) has been accepted into the cohort and SeedBridge has secured a $10k sponsor contribution that often converts to matching platform credits from our partners.

Quick context: Lumina is a two-person seed startup building an embeddings-first search layer for clinical research documents. They have modest immediate usage but expect a burst during customer pilots in Q4. Accelerator asks: a one-off matched credit (up to $10k) and an option for a 30-day trial extension to evaluate production costs.

Questions:
- Is Redwood able to provide sponsor-match credits for programs like SeedBridge?
- What qualification criteria do you require from the startup? (SOC2? company docs? ARR thresholds?)
- Timeline: we need a confirmation by Aug 12 to include in the cohort welcome kit.

I've attached the cohort acceptance certificate for Lumina and a short one-pager on expected usage levels. Happy to hop on a 20-min call if helpful.

Thanks,
Taylor

Partnerships Manager, SeedBridge

Subject: Re: Request: sponsor-match credits for Lumina (SeedBridge cohort 6)

Thanks Taylor — congrats to Lumina on the cohort!

Short answer: yes, we have a sponsor-match pathway for reputable accelerators. We typically approve a combination of credits and a limited-length trial extension. To speed this through approvals, we'll need a couple of things from Lumina:

- A copy of the cohort acceptance (you already shared, thanks)
- Confirmation of expected monthly token/embedding volume (ballpark is fine)
- Company registration docs (or a link to Crunchbase/Company house) and primary billing contact
- A short note on whether customer data will be sent to our hosted API (helps determine if Private/VPC is required)

Operational notes:
- Standard sponsor-match cap is $10,000 in hosted credits, plus a single 30-day trial extension. We can be flexible on extension length for early-stage partners on a case-by-case basis.
- Credits are tied to a HubSpot deal and have a 12-month expiry from activation.

Monica — can you flag any compliance/operational blockers for a tiny seed company sending non-PHI clinical metadata? Marissa — finance, does $10k matched sponsor credits need a special PO or can we approve through our promo credits ledger?

Taylor/Aisha — if you can send the token volume estimate and a billing contact, I can open the deal in HubSpot and route for sign-off. If you prefer a call, I'm free Thursday 8/6 10:00–11:30 PT.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Office: +1 415-555-0219

On Thu, Aug 6, 2026 at 09:22 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference> wrote:
> Monica — can you flag any compliance/operational blockers for a tiny seed company sending non-PHI clinical metadata?

Quick notes from Security/Onboarding:
- Non-PHI clinical metadata: acceptable on hosted with standard DPA controls. Ask: Lumina should confirm they will not upload patient-identifiable records during the pilot. If they anticipate PHI, we must route to Private (VPC) and that adds lead time.
- Proof of identity/company registration is enough for our credit program — SOC2 is not required for this level.
- For accelerator programs, we require an authorized signature from the program coordinator (Taylor) and the startup CEO (Aisha) to accept the credit terms.

Operational request: Monica attached our sponsor-match template (sponsor-match-terms.docx) — please sign (exec at SeedBridge) and have Aisha countersign. Once we receive signed terms and a billing contact, finance can issue the promo.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Onboarding & CS Operations, Redwood Inference
